title: Upgrade Deposit Credit on Paloma Business Proration
content:
On a Paloma Business upgrade, the proration charge carries an upgrade deposit credit decided by the deposits made to the balance in the three months before the day the proration is settled, counted from the day after the same calendar day three months earlier up to and including that day. Deposits by every method credited to the balance in the window are added together.

### Credit clause

Deposits totalling 100000.00 USD or more earn an upgrade deposit credit of 20.00 USD; deposits totalling 40000.00 USD up to 99999.99 USD earn 8.00 USD; smaller totals earn none.

The credit is a fixed amount in US dollars deducted from the proration charge; the charge after the deduction is never below 0.00 and is rounded half up to the cent.

### Questions answered

**Deposits of exactly 100000.00 USD in the window?** 20.00 USD.

**99999.99 USD?** 8.00 USD.

**39999.99 USD?** No upgrade deposit credit.

**A proration charge of 5.00 USD before the credit, with a credit of 8.00 USD?** The charge does not go below 0.00, so it is 0.00 USD.

**Which deposits count for a proration settled on 20 September?** Those received from 21 June through 20 September.
